title: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(4)
desc: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(4)

paragraphs.en: African conservation's emphasis on trophy hunting and game reserves can be traced to an international environmental conference, the first of its kind, which took place in London in 1900.
paragraphs.zh: 非洲野生动物保护工作对于战利品狩猎与猎物保护区的重视，可以追溯到1900年在伦敦举办的一场史无前例的国际环境会议。

paragraphs.en: There were no Black African representatives; rather, emergency discussions were held between foreign ministers of the various imperial powers in the hope of stemming the sudden decline in African wildlife caused by the excesses of European hunters, who had shot literally millions of animals in the space of a few decades.
paragraphs.zh: 会上没有非洲黑人代表；参会的是各个殖民帝国的外交部长，他们召开紧急磋商，希望遏制非洲野生动物数量骤降的趋势。造成这一现象的原因是欧洲猎手毫无节制的猎杀，短短数十年间就射杀了数百万只动物。

paragraphs.en: Shortly afterwards, the Society for the Preservation of the Fauna of the Empire was established to manage game licences across the colonial world.
paragraphs.zh: 不久之后，帝国动物保护协会宣告成立，负责管理所有殖民地范围内的狩猎许可证。

paragraphs.en: It was dubbed, observed the Times, the "Repentant Butchers Club".
paragraphs.zh: 《泰晤士报》曾评论，该协会被戏称为“悔过屠夫俱乐部”。

paragraphs.en: In the colonies, hunting with traps and snares – felt to be cruel, indiscriminate and, worse, unsporting – was outlawed, effectively criminalising Black African subsistence hunting overnight.
paragraphs.zh: 在各殖民地，使用陷阱与套索狩猎的行为被认定为残忍、不加区分，更重要的是有违狩猎精神，因而遭到取缔。一夜之间，非洲黑人赖以糊口的自给狩猎行为实际上就成了违法行为。

paragraphs.en: But trophy hunting, noble pursuit or not, was still practised on what can only be described as an unsportsmanlike scale.
paragraphs.zh: 然而战利品狩猎，无论算不算一项高尚的活动，其开展的规模却完全谈不上公平竞技。

paragraphs.en: Teddy Roosevelt, the US's "naturalist president", shot more than 500 animals with his son during an extended African safari in 1909.
paragraphs.zh: 素有“博物学家总统”之称的西奥多·罗斯福，1909年在非洲开启了一场长期游猎之旅，他和儿子一共猎杀了500多头动物。

paragraphs.en: These mega-hunts, reserved for blue bloods and celebrities, were increasingly formalised as "big-game safaris", with all the attendant rituals and stylings: the dining tents and gimlets and gun-bearers described by Hemingway.
paragraphs.zh: 这类专为贵族名流准备的大规模狩猎活动逐渐被定型为“大型猎物远征游猎”，衍生出一整套配套仪式与排场：海明威笔下描写过的就餐帐篷、金酒鸡尾酒以及持枪侍从一应俱全。

paragraphs.en: This was a romance so dazzling as to obscure the detail.
paragraphs.zh: 这段浪漫光环太过耀眼，以至于掩盖了背后的种种细节。

paragraphs.en: Many of the best-known heroes of African conservation started out as hunters, although this is not often well remembered.
paragraphs.zh: 许多非洲保护领域家喻户晓的先驱，早年都曾是猎手，不过这段过往常常被人们淡忘。

paragraphs.en: George and Joy Adamson, for example, were practically canonised in the popular media following Joy's 1960 memoir Born Free and its Hollywood adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 例如乔治·亚当森与乔伊·亚当森夫妇，自乔伊1960年出版回忆录《生而自由》并被好莱坞改编成电影之后，二人几乎被大众媒体奉为楷模。

paragraphs.en: Millions remember Elsa, the bottle-fed lion cub, with fondness; rather fewer the fact that it was George Adamson himself who shot her mother, albeit in self-defence.
paragraphs.zh: 无数人对那只人工喂养长大的幼狮艾尔莎满怀温情；却很少有人记得，正是乔治·亚当森亲手射杀了它的母亲，尽管当时属于自卫。

paragraphs.en: In many ways, life as a white conservationist on the private game reserves of Africa kept alive the world of aristocratic privilege that was fast fading from view in industrialising Europe.
paragraphs.zh: 从很多方面来看，白人保护者在非洲私人猎物保护区的生活，延续着贵族特权世界，而这样的生活在工业化进程中的欧洲早已日渐消亡。

paragraphs.en: These vast estates were often run as private fiefdoms riven by racial inequality; the preservation of wilderness and wild animals might have been the guiding principle, but flawed humans were at the helm.
paragraphs.zh: 这些广袤的庄园常常如同私人领地一般运作，充斥着种族不平等；荒野与野生动物保护或许是其行动纲领，但掌舵之人终究是有着缺陷的普通人。

paragraphs.en: Heavily armed and stewing in gin, landowners were apt to take policing of these new game laws into their own hands.
paragraphs.zh: 庄园主们全副武装、常常饮酒微醺，动辄就自行执行这套全新的狩猎法规。

paragraphs.en: In some regions of Africa, conservationists turned to aggressive military-style tactics in their bid to protect wildlife and wild lands from criminal organisations with multimillion-dollar ivory, horn and pangolin operations, which can be cold-blooded, merciless, and operating with the implicit backing of corrupt officials.
paragraphs.zh: 在非洲部分地区，野生动物保护人员开始采取激进的军事化手段，打击那些从事象牙、犀牛角以及穿山甲非法贸易、获利高达数百万美元的犯罪集团。这些团伙冷血无情，背后往往还有腐败官员暗中撑腰。

paragraphs.en: The militarised approach was pioneered in 1950s Kenya by the park wardens David Sheldrick and Bill Woodley, who repurposed experiences of guerrilla warfare during the Mau Mau rebellion, turning these same skills against Black Kenyans in a different context.
paragraphs.zh: 这种军事化保护模式最早于20世纪50年代在肯尼亚兴起，公园管理员戴维·谢尔德里克与比尔·伍德利借鉴了茅茅起义期间对抗游击战的作战经验，并把这套手段转而用来对付肯尼亚黑人。

paragraphs.en: Soon many parks and game reserves boasted their own armed patrols; the death penalty meted out to all those even suspected of poaching.
paragraphs.zh: 很快，众多国家公园与猎物保护区都组建起自己的武装巡逻队；哪怕只是有偷猎嫌疑的人，都有可能被判处死刑。

paragraphs.en: This has often been portrayed in the west as a kind of just war: a battle of good (rangers) against evil (poachers).
paragraphs.zh: 在西方叙事当中，这往往被描绘成一场正义之战：代表正义的护林员对抗代表邪恶的偷猎者。

paragraphs.en: But as a war, nonetheless.
paragraphs.zh: 但它终究是一场战争。

paragraphs.en: When, finally, Stone, the client, the trackers and I rattled back into camp, Derek Littleton, the director of the Luwire Conservancy, was waiting for us.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，当斯通斯、客户、追踪向导和我一路颠簸回到营地时，卢威尔保护区主管德里克·利特尔顿已经等候多时。

paragraphs.en: Littleton is a veteran conservationist who wears a veneer of calm, genteel dignity over a solid steel core.
paragraphs.zh: 利特尔顿是一名资深的野生动物保护者，外表沉稳优雅，内里却意志如钢。

paragraphs.en: He has run block L7 on wilderness-preservation principles for more than 20 years, having moved to Mozambique from Robert Mugabe's Zimbabwe.
paragraphs.zh: 他从罗伯特·穆加贝执政时期的津巴布韦迁居莫桑比克，二十多年来一直依照荒野保护原则管理L7狩猎区块。

paragraphs.en: He joined us for dinner.
paragraphs.zh: 他过来和我们一同进餐。

paragraphs.en: We ate sable antelope fillet, shot that very day.
paragraphs.zh: 我们享用了当天刚猎杀的黑马羚肉排。

paragraphs.en: The steak came rare and tender, raspberry-pink, paired with red wine.
paragraphs.zh: 肉排煎得三分熟、肉质鲜嫩，果肉呈现树莓般的粉红色，搭配着红酒。

paragraphs.en: We sat on a covered terrace, the night hot and still and - from somewhere beyond our circle of light, not far away - soundtracked by the cries and moans of the lions, fresh from a kill.
paragraphs.zh: 我们坐在带顶棚的露台上，夜晚闷热而寂静，从不远处灯光圈外的黑暗之中，传来刚刚捕猎完毕的狮子一声声的嘶吼与低吟。
